Register followup: build-config.test.ts REQ-PPH-04.1 runs a raw unmemoized `bun run build` against the real dist/ (rm -rf + rebuild). PRE-EXISTING, but this change widened its window from a 2-step to a 3-step build. One unreproduced full-suite failure was observed at S-000 (1 fail once, then 2191/0 across six runs, plus 2196/0 across four more at S-001). NARROWED 2026-07-25: bun `--parallel` is opt-in (Bun 1.3.14), there is no bunfig.toml, and both package.json#scripts.test and .github/workflows/ci.yml invoke plain `bun test` — so test FILES run sequentially and the cross-file race hypothesis is ruled out. Residual hazard is intra-process: PPH-04.1 wipes and rebuilds the real dist/ that the memoized ensureTscBuild() singleton has already handed to earlier consumers, so a failed or partial build there poisons every later reader (a cascade, which does not match the single observed failure). Root cause still UNDIAGNOSED. Fix direction: isolate PPH-04.1 to a scratch root.
